name: Hoskote Master Plan 2031
notes: Final approval under KTCP Act s.13(3), G.O. No. UDD 152 BMR 2013, Bengaluru, dated 30-01-2018 (read on the scanned GO, hoskote.tpa.gov.in 'final order'). Condition 1: subject to the High Court's final judgment in W.P. 4188/2016. Provisional approval UDD 152 BMR 2013 dated 16-09-2013. The GO approves the report and land-use maps; the zoning regulations are not named, so the ZR rows stay draft.

name: Nelamangala Master Plan 2031
notes: Final approval under KTCP Act s.13(3), G.O. No. UDD 150 BMR 2013, Bengaluru, dated 01-06-2015 (read on the scanned GO, nelamangala.tpa.gov.in 'FINAL'). Provisional approval UDD 150 BMR 2013 dated 16-09-2013. The GO approves the report and land-use maps, not the zoning regulations, so the ZR stays draft (no GO found for it). LPA later extended by 37 villages of Madhure hobli (UDD 141 BMR 2015, 08-12-2015), agricultural zone until the plan is revised: those villages are not covered by this plan's sheets.
